text_block_list.text: I stopped by the shrine with Calstone Light O, who has been stuck in a persistent slump lately...

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Put my handouts away, and they get crumpled in my bag;
take a walk through town, and roadwork forces endless detours—

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
As long as things like this keep happening,
nothing we do will work out.
choice_data_list: Come on now, don't say that, look.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: A fortune slip... is it?
choice_data_list: Just as a change of pace, you know?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Understood.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Th-This is—

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: The legendary "Direct Luck"...!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I had heard rumors about its existence before.
Something about how 'being covered in straight lines makes your luck soar'... or something like that...

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Come on, let's head into town and test our luck!
Down those straight stairs we go!

text_block_list.name: Japanese Sweet Shop Owner
text_block_list.text: Special sale on extra-long youkan shipped straight from the region!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"‘Direct delivery’...!
And a long, perfectly straight youkan...!
I'll take it...!"

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Mmh! Look at that ramen shop...!
Such a magnificent queue of customers... A truly beautiful straight line.
Let's line up and share in the good fortune!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Th-This is...
These noodles are...!

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
Haha, surprised, are ya?
It's our signature dish: Extra-Firm Sprint Noodles!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
What a straightaway...
It's just like the Niigata 1000m...!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: I shall partake with all my heart...!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
OOOOOOOOH!
My stomach is filling with straight-line power!

Whether it was due to a divine blessing remains uncertain,
but from that day on, Calstone Light O
seemed to have gotten back on track.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Small Blessing...
choice_data_list: W-Well, 'Small Blessing' is still a blessing...

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Disputes... "Will be settled peacefully"...!
Wishes... "Haste makes waste"...!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
It's hopeless... The more I struggle,
the further I get from the straight path...
It seems the road to recovery is still a long one...
